# Going Endo

> Find the AI worth doing. Going Endo helps leadership teams choose the AI use case that pays off for the business and the people it depends on.

Going Endo is available in the United States, the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, online or in person. The name means "going within": we work inside your company and your industry.

Going Endo does not build or sell technology. It helps you choose, and when the work needs specialists, it brings them in.

## Status

Not yet launched. Going Endo is inviting its first partners and clients now.

## How it works

1. Learn: see what AI can actually do in your industry today.
2. Choose: pick the one use case that pays off for your business and the people around it.
3. Plan: leave with a written assessment of that use case and a plan to test it.

## Two ways in

- AI Briefing: a single online session for the member companies of an association, chamber, or innovation agency. It shows what AI can do in their industry right now. There is no cost to the host organization.
- AI Workshop: an online or in person workshop for one company's leadership team. You leave with a written assessment of one AI use case: the value to your business and the people it affects, the risks, and a plan to test it. Workshop details come in a first conversation.

## Who it is for

Leadership teams of established companies, and the associations, chambers, and agencies that support them.

## Technologies

AI first. Then connected devices, robotics, and immersive technology where they fit.
